reviewedSources.title: Vainster App
reviewedSources.evidence: Original brief describes face mapping, weekly charts and an empathetic, positive personality. Original proposed organ/symptom inference is historical context, not validated capability.

reviewedSources.title: Vainster presentation
reviewedSources.evidence: Five-slide pitch focuses on mental/physical wellbeing and future propositions.

interpretation: A contemporary face observatory with capture phone, ceramic portrait, facial landmarks and a weekly visual journal. All screen content and journal entries are illustrative. No camera access, health inference, medical diagnosis or external API call occurs.
animation: 28 seconds: capture 0–5; scan 5–12; facial regions 12–19; journal 19–26; transition/reset 26–28. Manual selection freezes the chosen stage. Autoplay resumes continuously. Shared viewer handles pause, reduced motion and hidden-page suspension.

portrait.source: Microsoft Rocketbox Female_Adult_01_facial.fbx, derived from existing licensed learner.bin
portrait.changes: Baked pose, isolated head/neck, removed clothing and alpha surfaces, seam weld and two Loop-subdivision passes. Added ceramic shading and swept hair grooves. No real person's photo or health data used.

validation: node --test scripts/tests/vainster.test.mjs; npm run build; browser review of artwork, 3D, walkthrough and motion controls
